relations.subject: Dasharatha Sharma
relations.evidence: he studied in the city of Bikaner and at the University of Delhi.

relations.subject: Dasharatha Sharma
relations.role: head of the Department of History
relations.evidence: Sharma was the head of the Department of History at Hindu College, University of Delhi

relations.subject: Dasharatha Sharma
relations.evidence: and later was appointed Reader (equivalent of Associate Professor) in Ancient History at the University of Delhi.

relations.subject: Dasharatha Sharma
relations.role: Professor and Head of the Department of History; Dean of the Faculty of Arts
relations.evidence: In 1966, he was appointed as Professor and Head of the Department of History at the University of Jodhpur (now renamed Jai Narain Vyas University) and later became Dean of the Faculty of Arts

relations.subject: Dasharatha Sharma
relations.evidence: After retirement from the University of Jodhpur, Prof. Sharma served as Director of the Rajasthan Puratattva Mandir near the Rajasthan Oriental Research Institute in Jodhpur.
